svg.title: From award to contract signing
svg.desc: The officer records the award; the system checks duties, declarations and the abandoned-work list, then starts the appeal period. When it ends, the officer drafts the contract, records the guarantee and records the signing, which converts the reservation to a commitment and writes the outbox in one transaction.
